sources.authors: Vincent Cachia and Valentin A. Zagrebnov
sources.scope: Trace-norm Trotter results under Gibbs factor hypotheses. Bare K on the noncompact target is not asserted Gibbs. The new actual A_theta retains original confinement. The report separately proves trace tightness for its effective generators.
Banach-valued Vitali and Cauchy derivatives, already used by655. Applied here in trace class after actual trace-norm convergence and locally uniform Gibbs bounds are proved.

operator_log_order: Used via its resolvent-integral proof; operator exponential monotonicity is not asserted.
new_result: Common confinement lower bound for the new original-HF regrouping controls the changing Gibbs state, real records and energy/entropy together.
